messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses"
set: ["this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses", "eight 50 mg tablets a day", "dose is given in 3 divided doses", "given in divided doses", "taken in divided doses", "2000 mg/day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses", "150 mg orally per day in divided doses", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "this amount corresponds to one or two 50 mg tablets", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses for narcolepsy", "50 mg", "450 mg/day in up to 4 divided doses", "50 mg a day, split into smaller doses", "this recommendation includes cisplatin doses of 50 mg/m2 or greater"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
